svg.title: Annual CH₄ and N₂O sums per site-year at the peat site Särkisuo and the mineral sites Anttila and Viikki, with the 2022 values of Shurpali et al. (2025).
svg.desc: Two bar charts of annual sums per site-year: CH₄ in kg CH₄ ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹ (left; Anttila and Särkisuo 2022 and 2023) and N₂O in kg N₂O ha⁻¹ yr⁻¹ (right; also Viikki 2022 to 2025). A lighter, hatched bar with an asterisk is a partial year (coverage below 90%). Black diamonds with a bar are the 2022 values and ranges of Shurpali et al. (2025) Table 3. CH₄: Anttila 2022 2.34; Anttila 2023 2.73; Särkisuo 2022 103 (partial, coverage 0.66); Särkisuo 2023 128. N₂O: Anttila 2022 3.85; Anttila 2023 1.70; Särkisuo 2022 16.0 (partial, coverage 0.66); Särkisuo 2023 11.3; Viikki 2022 16.8; Viikki 2023 5.56; Viikki 2024 4.58; Viikki 2025 6.43. Shurpali 2022 Anttila CH₄: 2.0 (2.0 to 3.0); this dive 2.34. Shurpali 2022 Särkisuo CH₄: 110 (110 to 120); this dive 103. Shurpali 2022 Anttila N₂O: 3.8 (3.7 to 4.0); this dive 3.85. Shurpali 2022 Särkisuo N₂O: 16 (16 to 17); this dive 16.0. Ratio Särkisuo / Anttila of the annual CH₄ sum: 2022 44, 2023 47 (Särkisuo 2022 is a partial year). Ratio Särkisuo / Anttila of the annual N₂O sum: 2022 4.2, 2023 6.6 (Särkisuo 2022 is a partial year). If the Viikki N₂O unit is N₂O-N (open finding VII-06, status: waits for provider), the Viikki bars are 1.57 times higher (2022: 26.3).
